points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, demonstrating capability to build robust model architectures for business problems.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of feature data for predictive models.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable model validation.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing processing overhead by ~80% per query and enabling efficient handling of large-scale financial data.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, improving system availability and performance.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable ML applications using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for production deployment.
